model.group_rule: hidden_dim / 8 in the 17 central spatial convolutions
model.activation_policy: upstream ReLU at A32, clamp[0,1]+uniform quantization at lower modes; stem ReLU and linear bottleneck/residual paths are FP exceptions
model.batchnorm: five independent banks at every BatchNorm location

protocol.training_loss: hard CE at 32; detached recursive soft CE at 8/4/2/1; gradients summed; one Adam step per global batch
protocol.checkpoint_policy: diagnostic partial-epoch checkpoint only; any later full training starts from zero

timing_scope: Each step contains all five precision forwards; training also contains five backwards and one Adam update. No extra factor five.
memory_scope: PyTorch caching-allocator allocated/reserved/peak counters and CUDA device-free bytes; not physical residency or Windows shared GPU memory.
